card.name: Plural nouns after published numerous
card.fires_on: Plural nouns, or the word right after them, in author bios saying someone has published or won many papers, articles, awards or the like. Also nearby linking words in such lists of achievements.

modes.label: Papers and articles published
modes.description: The plural work noun after 'published numerous' in a biography.
modes.example: has published numerous<< papers>> in these areas.

modes.label: Words after the plural noun
modes.description: A preposition or comma right after a plural count of items or people.
modes.example: has published numerous papers<< in>> these areas.

modes.label: Awards or resolutions
modes.description: Plural noun for honors or formal acts that follow a verb like won or passed.
modes.example: has won<< awards>> for his books

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning many, such as numerous, multiple and frequent.
card.plain: It marks spots in a bio where a person's many papers or awards are being listed, so a word like 'numerous' fits.
